skill.summary: Shorten URLs using is.gd (no auth required). Returns a permanent short link.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the "shorten" skill.
- Allows instant URL shortening using the is.gd service with no authentication required.
- Generates permanent short links for easy sharing.
- Simple usage: provide any long URL to receive a short is.gd link.
- No analytics dashboard; links are straightforward redirects.
- Rate limits apply—use responsibly.
